items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: And then sometimes we used to do a Good Morning Blues program which was early in the morning, that consist of Mel Powell piano, Emmett Barry, George Johnson clarinet and saxophone, Billy Taylor bass and me

ctx.x: Well that was a great experience. See I was one of the first black drummers to be on staff at CBS. There was four of us altogether.
